scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k "cross-env PLATFORM=DESKTOP TARGET=MAC next dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env PLATFORM=DESKTOP TARGET=MAC electron ."
scripts.build:desktop: cross-env PLATFORM=DESKTOP TARGET=MAC next build && electron-builder
scripts.build:desktop:win: cross-env PLATFORM=DESKTOP TARGET=WIN next build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:desktop:mac: cross-env PLATFORM=DESKTOP TARGET=MAC next build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:desktop:lin: cross-env PLATFORM=DESKTOP TARGET=LIN next build && electron-builder --linux
